# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.10

Version 1.4.10 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.9

A further check of the game itself and of the 64-bit builds. Fixed:

- **No more random bytes in the save from a villager's notice** (every build). When a villager buries something,
  the notice they put up on the message board was built in memory that was only partly filled, and the rest of its
  text (14 bytes) went into the save as whatever was there before. Nothing showed on the board, but the save held
  stray bytes that differed from build to build. The notice is now cleared first, as the game already does for its
  other notices.
- **Windows and Android find the GBA files on the disc.** At boot the game looks for the GBA design editor in the
  disc's `agb_special` archive. A function of the C library that Windows and Android define differently from Linux
  turned the `_` in that name into another character, so the files were not found ("AGB data file not found" in
  the log). There is no GBA to send them to on PC, so nothing showed, but the game now reads the disc the same way
  on every system.
- A smaller fix that never showed: when the game works out the days villagers talk about the harvest moon, it
  read a year it had not set (the dates came out right anyway).
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

### A correction to v1.4.7's checks

The 32-bit/64-bit comparison described in v1.4.7 started most of its scenarios from a save that turned out to be
empty (the script that makes it stopped pressing just before the game wrote it), so most of those runs only reached
the new-game prompt, and the numbers given then (35 scenarios, 815 screenshots) overstated what had been compared.
The script is fixed and everything was run again, more than before (below). Another test script, the one for Nook's
part-time job, had silently stopped after its second step in this town; it is fixed too.

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.4.10 can be in the same room, and 32-bit and
  64-bit players can play together.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.10-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.10-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.10-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.10-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

The same scripted play on a 32-bit and a 64-bit build, comparing every screenshot pixel for pixel, the logged
positions and the saves:

- built with gcc (the compiler of the Windows and Linux builds): 36 scenarios (the opening, building interiors and
  saving, the town by day, night and rain, the Famicom, the device menus, several days with letters, K.K. Slider,
  the house loan and events, the Korean text editor), 845 screenshots: all identical, and so are the saves;
- built with clang (the compiler of the Android build): the same 36 scenarios and 845 screenshots: all identical;
- Nook's part-time job from start to end: 76 screenshots with gcc and 75 with clang, all identical,
  and the saves at every step;
- house expansions, the basement and the upper floor, buying the island and the boat trip there and back: 141 screenshots and the saves identical;
- the whole town on 11 days through the year (Christmas Eve, New Year's Day, snow, Valentine's Day, cherry
  blossoms, May, July, the fireworks, September, Halloween, a rainy night): 330 screenshots identical;
- 19 Famicom games: 304 screenshots and their sound identical;
- with the HD texture pack ACHD V25: 84 screenshots identical;
- 64-bit Windows (under Wine) against 64-bit Linux: saving, a letter and the house loan, 84 screenshots
  and the saves identical.

Also:

- Multiplayer between a 32-bit host and a 64-bit guest: joining, the town sent to the guest, chat.
- A 64-bit build with AddressSanitizer and UBSan bounds checks through all of the above (50 runs): no memory
  errors. The out-of-range reads that remain are in the original game's code and work the same way on every build
  (listed in the docs).
- Valgrind (memcheck) on the 64-bit build: no use of uninitialised memory other than the harvest
  moon's year (fixed), and nothing uninitialised written into a save.
- All unit tests pass. The decomp changes are inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.10, versionCode 10410).

Details: [docs/64bit.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/64bit.md#further-checks-v1410).

## Known limitations

- On the first day, nothing can be saved before you have met a villager: the game itself does not allow it.
- No test on a real arm64 device was possible here; arm64 runs the same 64-bit code that was checked on x86_64.
- In Korean mode, passwords cannot be entered: their characters are kana and symbols that the Korean patch's
  input has no keys for, and its font shows some pairs of them as one Hangul syllable. This is how the patch is
  made, also on the GameCube.
- The limitations of v1.4.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
